reviews.body: Thanks, this closes #1668 at its cause: a control with no text gives the destructive-action guard nothing to classify, so the crawl must not click it. Listing it in `notJudged` with a reason, and keeping `confirmDangerous` as the opt-in, is right. Both directions are tested. One note for later, not a blocker: `HAS_TEXT = /"/` depends on the snapshot quoting every name, value and own text. If that format ever changes, this check changes with it.

comments.body: Thanks for your first pull request to Reticle! A maintainer aims to review within two days. Before then, `pnpm verify` locally catches most of what CI will, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the rest. If CI does not start, a maintainer needs to approve it for first-time contributors; that is normal.
